title: Add general error handling to MCP controller tool dispatch
description: P1 — McpController.DelegateToCatalogAsync calls tool.Execute(...) without a catch block. Unhandled exceptions from tool execution (null ref, argument exception, etc.) propagate as raw ASP.NET 500 HTML rather than properly formatted JSON-RPC error responses, breaking the MCP protocol. Fix: wrap tool.Execute in try/catch, log the exception, return a correctly structured JSON-RPC error response with proper error code, message, and data fields. Found in 10-agent codebase audit 2026-07-10 (P1-011).
